title: NAFC genomic-neighborhood analysis scripts
description: Analysis scripts for the article "Wetland-root microbial genomes contain recurrent multi-gene neighborhoods with potential relevance to naphthenic acid fractional compound transformation". The workflow covers MAG recovery and abundance, Prokka annotation, phylogenomics, a curated 667-protein reference-panel BLASTP screen of 365 genomes, candidate genomic-neighborhood reconstruction, iTOL dataset generation, architecture signatures, annotation confirmation, ROW versus OSPW comparison, and figure generation.
